name: RETINOL PALMITATE 50 MG 40 CAPSULES
description: Retinyl palmitate in 50 mg capsules is a vitamin A supplement. This product is primarily used to treat deficiencies of this vitamin, which is essential for vision, growth, bone development, and tissue maintenance. The best-known brand in this form is Retigel, from Gelpharma Laboratories. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
